Subject: Re: Partnership kickoff — high level timeline request

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the intro call today — really excited to get Redwood into our stack. We want to make sure the first 90 days are executable and have clear acceptance criteria so our security and SRE teams can sign off. Can you send the MAP template you use and a proposed milestone timeline from kickoff to production?

High level constraints from our side:
- Dedicated VPC + SOC2 evidence required before ingesting PII
- Pilot dataset availability week of July 12
- Production scale goals: 5k requests/day by end of Q3

Appreciate a rough sequence (who owns what, dates, and acceptance gates). If you can include a short checklist for the security review that would help speed procurement.

Best,
Asha Reddy
Head of Partnerships, Orchid AI

Hi Asha — great speaking earlier. Attaching our standard MAP template (MAP-OrchidAI-v1.xlsx) and the draft SOW that mirrors the pilot scope.

Quick proposal (first pass):
1) Week 0 (Kickoff) — Jun 29: Align stakeholders, add SRE + security contacts to shared drive (owner: Neha). Acceptance gate: kickoff notes + stakeholder RACI
2) Week 2 — Jul 12: Pilot dataset handover + environment provisioned (owner: Orchid ops / Redwood infra). Acceptance gate: data access test + KMS keys exchanged
3) Week 4 — Jul 26: Pilot run & smoke tests (owner: Ben Carter). Acceptance gate: automated smoke test pass; latency within agreed SLOs
4) Week 7 — Aug 16: Security & compliance sign-off; retention policy agreed (owner: Priyom Das). Acceptance gate: SOC2 evidence checklist items provisioned + signed NDA addendum if needed
5) Week 12 — Sep 06: Production cutover & monitoring cadence (owner: Laura Bennett). Acceptance gate: traffic ramp to 5k req/day with no more than 2% error rate; runbook handoff complete

Open items for you:
- Confirm people who will own data handover and the primary SRE reviewer
- Any procurement/contract deadlines we should know about? (SOW-draft-OrchidAI.pdf attached)

I'll loop Ben and Priyom for technical dependencies and the security checklist. If the dates above look tight we can shift the pilot by a week.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-OrchidAI-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-draft-OrchidAI.pdf (pdf)
